panels.title: Segment Maturity Level Over Time
panels.description: Monthly distribution of segments across maturity levels (1=Initial, 2=Managed, 3=Defined, 4=Predictable, 5=Optimizing)

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly_levels AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', observed_at) as month,
    project,
    CASE
      WHEN score >= 0.9 THEN 5
      WHEN score >= 0.7 THEN 4
      WHEN score >= 0.5 THEN 3
      WHEN score >= 0.3 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END as maturity_level
  FROM metrics
  WHERE metric_key = 'overall_maturity_score'
  AND observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$months_back months'
),
level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    maturity_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT project) as project_count
  FROM monthly_levels
  GROUP BY month, maturity_level
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(month, 'Mon YYYY') as "Month",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN maturity_level = 1 THEN project_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Initial (1)",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN maturity_level = 2 THEN project_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Managed (2)",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN maturity_level = 3 THEN project_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Defined (3)",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN maturity_level = 4 THEN project_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Predictable (4)",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN maturity_level = 5 THEN project_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Optimizing (5)",
  SUM(project_count) as "Total"
FROM level_counts
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC;

panels.title: Top 5 Performing Segments (Latest Scores)
panels.description: Top 5 segments ranked by most recent maturity score

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_segment_scores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_json->>'segment')
    metric_json->>'segment' as segment_name,
    score,
    observed_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT project) OVER (PARTITION BY metric_json->>'segment') as project_count,
    CASE
      WHEN score >= 0.9 THEN 'Optimizing (5)'
      WHEN score >= 0.7 THEN 'Predictable (4)'
      WHEN score >= 0.5 THEN 'Standardized (3)'
      WHEN score >= 0.3 THEN 'Managed (2)'
      ELSE 'Initial (1)'
    END as maturity_level
  FROM metrics
  WHERE metric_key = 'segment_maturity_score'
  AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY metric_json->>'segment', observed_at DESC
)
SELECT
  segment_name as "Team",
  ROUND((score * 100)::numeric, 2) as "Latest Score %",
  maturity_level as "Level (Latest)",
  project_count as "Projects"
FROM latest_segment_scores
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 5;

options.content:
## Monthly Report Export

### How to Export for Presentations:

1. **Screenshot/PNG Export:**
   - Click the panel title → Share → Link
   - Copy direct link or use panel screenshot
   - Paste into PowerPoint slides

2. **CSV/Excel Export:**
   - Click panel menu (⋮) → Inspect → Data
   - Click "Download CSV"
   - Import into Excel for further formatting

3. **PDF Export (requires Grafana Image Renderer):**
   - Dashboard menu → Share → PDF
   - Configure layout and export

### Data Freshness:
- Tables update every 30 seconds
- Data reflects all runs in database
- Use time range picker for historical views

### Notes:
- Insights panel excluded per user request
- Manual insights still required for slides
- Segment filtering available if needed
